「島の交易路」の遊び方: 島と資源、はじめの置き方、手番の流れ、建てるものの費用: How to play Isle Routes: the island and its resources, the opening placement, the turn, building costs, the 7 and the robber, trading, development cards and scoring.
はじめての人向けに、「島の交易路」の遊び方を短くまとめました。読み終えたら、その: A short guide to Isle Routes for first-time players. When you are done, try it right away in Play the AI.
4人で遊びます。資源を集めて道・村・街を建て、<b>自分の手番のあいだに10点<: Four players gather resources and build roads, villages and towns. The first to reach 10 points during their own turn wins.
島は19枚の六角形の土地でできています。土地ごとに出る資源が決まっています。: The island is made of 19 hexagonal lands. Each land produces one kind of resource.
砂漠以外の土地には2〜12の数字が置かれています（7はありません）。サイコロ2つ: Every land except the desert has a number from 2 to 12 (there is no 7). When the two dice add up to that number, villages and towns on the corners of that land receive its resource.
<span class=\"k\">学び</span>数字の出やすさは、6と8が: Takeaway6 and 8 roll the most often (5 times in 36), and 2 and 12 the least (once in 36). The dots under each number on the board show how many times in 36 rolls it comes up. You can roughly measure a village spot by adding up the dots around it.
1番手から4番手の順に、村を1つと、その村につながる道を1本置きます。: In seat order from 1st to 4th, each player places one village and one road touching it.
次に4番手から1番手の逆の順に、もう1組の村と道を置きます。: Then, in reverse order from 4th to 1st, each player places a second village and road.
2つ目の村のまわりの土地から、資源を1枚ずつもらってゲームが始まります。: Each player takes one resource from every land around their second village, and the game begins.
村はどの村からも<b>2辺以上</b>離して置きます（隣の角には置けません）。こ: A village must be at least two edges away from every other village (never on a neighboring corner). This also applies during the game.
<span class=\"k\">学び</span>はじめの2つの村で、ゲーム: TakeawayYour two opening villages decide most of your income for the game. Compare the total dots, how many of the five resources you cover, and whether a harbor is nearby.
<b>サイコロを振る</b>: 出た数字の土地に接する村は1枚、街は2枚の資源を: Roll the dice: every village next to a land with that number receives 1 resource, and every town 2 (this applies to all players).
<b>建てる・交換する・発展カードを使う</b>: 好きな順で、何回でもできます: Build, trade and play development cards in any order, as often as you like (at most one development card per turn).
<b>手番を終える</b>: 左隣の人の番になります。: End your turn: play passes to the next player.
自分の道・村・街から延ばす。村を建てる場所まで届かせる: Extends from your road, village or town. Reach new spots for villages
自分の道がつながった空き角に建てる: Built on an empty corner your road reaches
自分の村を建て替える。資源が2枚ずつになる: Upgrades one of your villages. It then receives 2 resources per roll
山から1枚引く（下を参照）: Draw one from the deck (see below)
駒には上限があります: 道15本・村5つ・街4つ。: Pieces are limited: 15 roads, 5 villages and 4 towns.
手札が<b>8枚以上</b>の人は、半分（切り捨て）を捨てます。: Anyone holding 8 or more cards discards half of them (rounded down).
振った人は盗賊を別の土地へ動かし、その土地に村か街を持つ人から1枚を無作為に奪い: The player who rolled moves the robber to another land and takes one random card from a player with a village or town on it.
盗賊のいる土地は、数字が出ても資源を出しません。: A land with the robber on it produces nothing when its number is rolled.
<span class=\"k\">学び</span>7はいちばん出やすい目（3: Takeaway7 is the most common roll (6 times in 36). If you end your turn holding 8 or more cards, you risk losing half of them.
自分の手番に、銀行と<b>同じ資源4枚を好きな資源1枚</b>に交換できます。港: On your turn you can trade 4 of the same resource for any 1 resource with the bank. With a village or town on a harbor corner, you trade at that harbor's rate.
3:1 の港: どの資源でも3枚を1枚に。: 3:1 harbor: 3 of any one resource for 1.
2:1 の港: 決まった1種類の資源を2枚で1枚に。: 2:1 harbor: 2 of its specific resource for 1.
このサイトでは、プレイヤーどうしの交換はまだできません（銀行と港だけ）。: Trading between players is not available on this site yet (bank and harbors only).
山は25枚。買った手番には使えず（得点カードは別）、使えるのは1手番に1枚までで: The deck has 25 cards. You cannot play a card on the turn you buy it (point cards count right away), and you may play at most one per turn.
盗賊を動かして1枚奪う。サイコロの前にも使える: Move the robber and take one card. Can be played before rolling
持っているだけで1点（見せずに持っておける）: Worth 1 point just by holding it (kept hidden)
銀行から好きな資源を2枚もらう: Take any two resources from the bank
資源を1種類言い、ほかの全員からその資源を全部もらう: Name a resource; every other player gives you all of theirs
<span class=\"k\">学び</span>9点のときに発展カードを買: TakeawayAt 9 points, buying a development card wins on the spot if it is a point card. In this site's research we found positions where the AI missed this and lost a lot of winning chances, and we fixed it.
最長の道（5本以上つながった道で一番長い人。同じ長さなら先に持っていた人のまま）: Longest road (the longest connected road of at least 5; on a tie, the current holder keeps it)
最大の騎士（騎士を3枚以上使い、一番多い人）: Largest army (most knights played, at least 3)
